# kopia_notification_profile (List Resource)

Lists the notification profiles of the Kopia server that `kopia_notification_profile` can manage — email, Pushover and webhook profiles — for `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later), sorted by name. Each result is named after the profile and carries its name as the identity of `kopia_notification_profile`, ready for an `import` block.

Listing reads no setting of any profile. With `include_resource = true` every profile is also read the way Terraform reads one right after importing it, which takes one request per profile and puts its settings in the results — SMTP password, Pushover tokens, webhook URL and headers included, in the attributes `kopia_notification_profile` marks sensitive — and in configuration generated from them.

Profiles the resource cannot manage are left out with a warning that names them: those of another method, such as `testsender`, those without a method, and those whose name Kopia's API cannot address. With `include_resource = true`, so are those whose settings Kopia stores in a form the provider cannot read, as reading them is what shows it; without it they are listed, and importing one fails. The `kopia_notification_profiles` data source lists every profile. The list takes no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or newer. Profiles the provider cannot
# manage, such as those of Kopia's testsender method, are left out with a
# warning that names them.
list "kopia_notification_profile" "all" {
  provider = kopia
}

# Reading each profile in full takes one request per profile, and puts its
# secrets (SMTP password, Pushover tokens, webhook URL and headers) in the
# results and in configuration generated from them.
list "kopia_notification_profile" "detailed" {
  provider         = kopia
  include_resource = true
}
```
